Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato — just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 ⸻ 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g garlic butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping ⸻ Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. ⸻ 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. ⸻ 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan ⸻ 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #bakedpotato #lasagna

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. I hope you enjoy this simple and delicious recipe and follow for more! #fyp #BakeWithMe #sweettooth #cinnamonroll #viralvideo

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

🍰 High-Protein Greek Yogurt Cheesecake Protein-packed, creamy, and incredibly easy to make. You’ll need: • 28 oz (800 g) full-fat Greek yogurt • 2 eggs • 4 tbsp semolina (or 3 tbsp cornstarch) • 1 tbsp vanilla extract • Sweetener, to taste • Fresh berries How to make it: 1. Preheat the oven to 390°F (200°C). 2. Whisk together the yogurt, eggs, vanilla, semolina, and sweetener until smooth. 3. Fold in the berries. 4. Pour into a parchment-lined baking dish. 5. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until lightly golden. 6. Cool completely, then chill for at least 2 hours before serving. ✨ Tip: It tastes even better the next day! Approximate nutrition (whole cheesecake): 1,180 kcal | 92g Protein | 51g Fat | 82g Carbs ❤️ Save this recipe for later!

Here’s an easy grilled steak with crispy potatoes and asparagus recipe. 🥩🥔🌱 🥩 Grilled Steak Ingredients * 1–2 ribeye, sirloin, or NY strip steaks * 1 tbsp olive oil * Salt * Black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1 tbsp butter * 2 cloves garlic, smashed * Fresh rosemary or thyme (optional) Instructions 1. Take the steaks out of the fridge 20–30 minutes before cooking. 2. Pat them dry and coat lightly with olive oil. 3. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 4. Heat your grill to high heat. 5. Grill for about 4–5 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness. 6. During the last minute, add butter, garlic, and rosemary/thyme. 7. Remove and let the steak rest 5–10 minutes before cutting. 🥔 Crispy Potatoes Ingredients * 1 lb baby potatoes * 1–2 tbsp olive oil * Salt & pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning Instructions 1. Cut potatoes in half. 2. Toss with oil and seasonings. 3. Roast at 425°F for 25–35 minutes, flipping halfway. 4. For extra crispiness, broil for 2–3 minutes at the end. 🌱 Grilled Asparagus Ingredients * 1 bunch asparagus * 1 tbsp olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * A little lemon juice Instructions 1. Trim the woody ends. 2. Toss asparagus with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. Grill over medium-high heat for 5–8 minutes, turning occasionally. 4. Finish with fresh lemon juice. 🔥 Best way to serve it Put the sliced steak over a plate of crispy potatoes with the grilled asparagus on the side. Add a little of the garlic butter from the steak over everything. 👌#tiktokgrowthchallenge #food

Make the viral potato snack with me🥔💛🥢  🏷️Recipe:  🥔 Ingredients * 2 potatoes * 75 ml water * A pinch of salt & pepper * 50–60g tapioca starch  👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Add the potatoes, water, salt, and pepper to a blender and blend until smooth. 2. Microwave for 40 seconds, then stir. Repeat 2–3 times, stirring after every 40 seconds. 3. Mix in 50–60 g of tapioca starch until fully combined. 4. Transfer the mixture to a piping bag. 5. Pipe the mixture directly into hot oil and snip into small pieces. 6. Leave some space between each piece so they don't stick together. 7. Fry until golden brown and crispy. 8. Even my mom loved it—and she is not easily impressed. Yeah… this is staying in the rotation. Inspired by @wickdconfections 💛 Hot Collard Green & Smoked Turkey Dip Ingredients • 1¼ cups smoked turkey leg meat, shredded • 2½–3 cups pre-cooked collard greens, VERY well drained Creamy base • 2½–3 oz plain whipped cream cheese • 1/2 cup sour cream • 1/4 cup mayonnaise Cheese • 1/2–2/3 cup smoked gouda, shredded • 3/4 cup mozzarella, divided • 1/4 cup parmesan Seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika • Pinch cayenne or red pepper flakes • 1–2 tsp hot sauce • 1–2 tbsp pot liquor (from the pot of greens or juice from the pot of the cooked smoked turkey leg) or broth • 1–2 tsp vinegar (optional) ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Drain greens VERY well and squeeze out excess liquid. Adjust with vinegar, salt, and hot sauce. 	2.	Chop most of the greens, blend about 1/2 cup with a little broth until smooth. 	3.	Mix cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, seasonings, hot sauce, and blended greens until smooth. 	4.	Fold in smoked turkey leg meat, chopped greens, gouda, parmesan, and half the mozzarella. Add liquid if needed. 	5.	Let sit 5–10 minutes. 	6.	Spread into greased dish, top with remaining mozzarella. 	7.	Bake at 375°F for 15–20 minutes, then broil 2–3 minutes until golden. 	8.	Finish with a drizzle of hot sauce and smoked paprika. #over40 #wlw #FoodTok #viralrecipe
